actual: AIstock currently has one online Windows self-hosted runner carrying CI, CodeQL, Semgrep, PR quality and heavy scheduled lanes. Independent jobs serialize even though the host has capacity for two bounded runner instances. Implement role-specific fast/security labels, exact isolated runner provisioning and health verification without CI dependency installation, preserve one-heavy-job concurrency, and add a contract proving policy evidence stays inside one fast scanner rather than becoming independent required jobs or approvals.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.

expected: Two distinct online Windows runner roles execute general and security lanes in isolated workspaces; provisioning is exact and hash-verified, and all policy evidence remains inside one fast scanner step rather than becoming separate jobs or approvals.
non_goals: Do not start, stop, or restart any user backend without explicit per-target approval.

Do not run business experiments, database validation, DDL, DML, or dependency installation.
